results.question: Who are the best auto repair shops in Poplar Bluff, MO?

chatgpt.text:
If it were my family car in Poplar Bluff, I’d start with these:

1. **Plaza Tire Service – 1036 W Pine St.** Best all-around pick for tires, brakes, alignment, oil changes, and quick turnaround; it shows strong review volume/rating locally. ([loc8nearme.com](https://www.loc8nearme.com/missouri/poplar-bluff/auto-repair/?utm_source=openai))

2. **Christian Automotive & Tire – 2235 S Westwood Blvd.** Good “one shop” option for bumper-to-bumper work; they advertise ASE-certified mechanics and handle tires, wheels, and auto repair. ([christianautotire.com](https://www.christianautotire.com/?utm_source=openai))

3. **Barker’s Towing & Auto Repair.** I’d use them if the car may need a tow plus repair—review sites consistently list them highly for both. ([reviews.birdeye.com](https://reviews.birdeye.com/barkers-towing-auto-repair-156045601623868?utm_source=openai))

4. **Richard’s Roadware – 515 Washington St.** Worth calling for general repair and tire-related help; local review summaries highlight long-time customer satisfaction. ([loc8nearme.com](https://www.loc8nearme.com/missouri/poplar-bluff/richards-roadware-llc/4311270/?utm_source=openai))

5. **Matt’s Auto – 1637 State Hwy AA.** Smaller independent shop with solid ratings; good candidate for a second estimate on repairs. ([reviews.birdeye.com](https://reviews.birdeye.com/d/auto-repair/poplar-bluff-mo/?utm_source=openai))

For bigger jobs, get a written estimate and ask what parts/labor warranty they offer.

gemini.text:
If a neighbor asked me where to take their car in Poplar Bluff, these are the top three local shops I’d recommend:

1. **Stancil’s Auto Repair**: Known around town for honest, straightforward service. They excel at engine diagnostics and general repairs. They won't upsell you on unnecessary parts, and their prices are very fair. 

2. **M & M Automotive**: Excellent for comprehensive, bumper-to-bumper repairs. The mechanics here are experienced and take the time to explain what’s wrong in plain English. They're reliable, thorough, and stand firmly behind their work.

3. **Bargain Barn Tire & Auto**: My top pick for tires, brakes, suspension work, and routine maintenance (like oil changes). They are fast, reasonably priced, and run by friendly folks who treat you like family. It’s the perfect spot for everyday car care.

**Tip:** Try to call ahead for an appointment at any of these spots—they stay busy because the locals trust them!
